errors.what: Wheel angle is not a monotonic indexing motion. It reads about 132 deg at t=3.67s, jumps to 180 deg at t=0 (the pin-on-centre-line instant), then drops back to about 137.6 deg at t=0.33s and rests at 135 deg. A real Geneva wheel advances one step (360/n) in one direction across the engagement window and then holds. This one overshoots and snaps back, so the indexing motion is wrong.

The wheel advance per indexing cycle does not match the slot count. Between rest at 135 deg and mid-engagement at 180 deg the offset is 45 deg. For n=4 the step would be 90 deg (45 deg each side of the centre line), so the wheel does not complete a full step per revolution.

At t=0.00s the wheel is drawn as a diamond with the arms in a different configuration from the rest of the frames, and the pin or arm overlaps the wheel. The wheel geometry does not match the locked position, so the rendered wheel pose disagrees with the wheel_deg panel.

The wheel is a few thin line segments, not a slotted Maltese-cross wheel. The pin does not visibly sit in a slot during engagement, and a locking arc or disc is missing, so locking between steps is not shown. The wheel is also stationary for about 300 deg of driver rotation with no visible lock.
